note: Bradford County park atop Barclay Mountain around 30-acre Sunfish Pond, near Canton PA (Leroy Twp). 38 electric-only RV sites plus about a dozen tent sites and primitive cabins; dump station, showers, camp store. Seasonal: May 9 - October 11 in 2026. Standard site $45/night (2026). A few RV sites sit along the pond. Park supervisor 570-250-5414. --Claude
summary: Confirmed showers/camp store/dump and a seasonal campground. Added the 2026 $45 standard-site rate, electric-only RV sites (no water/sewer), 38 RV sites, the May 9 - October 11 2026 season. Not stated: amperage, how nightly sites are booked (only seasonal sites take applications/reservations), site lengths.
flags: Missing website: Bradford County's own page https://www.bradfordcountypa.gov/339/Sunfish-Pond (the entry has none).

Booking: the county states no nightly reservation channel; the 2026 rules only describe applications and deposits for seasonal sites ($900 seasonal vs $45 daily). Nightly camping is presumably walk-up via the park supervisor (570-250-5414), but the pages do not say so, and they do not say how many of the 38 RV sites are let seasonally.
